caption: The drawing depicts a pink and green bird perched on a gray and brown branch in the upper left section of the composition. The bird has a reddish-pink head and chest, green wings with blue and black accents, and a pointed crest. Surrounding the bird is an arrangement of flowers and leaves. The flowers are white, pink, red, and purple, with the white flowers grouped mostly toward the right side and the larger red and pink flowers on the lower left and upper right. The leaves are primarily shades of brown, green, and yellow, and are interspersed among the flowers. The background is a light tan oval, and the entire composition is set on a rectangular, off-white surface. There is a handwritten signature, “Rex Bush,” in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Embroidered Picture
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
